patch_description:
Add a short second-stage continuation after each broad soft optimization restart. The existing schedule ends at beta=120, which still averages several nearly active closest and diameter pairs. For a diameter-packing optimum, the final improvement is controlled by the exact contact graph, so a higher-beta stage better approximates the true minimum-distance versus maximum-distance objective.

The Adam state is reset before this stage because the earlier broad-force momentum is no longer appropriate once only contact pairs matter. The reduced learning rate avoids disrupting the already good configuration while allowing contact constraints to settle. This is a targeted refinement that preserves the existing restart strategy and normalization invariances.
